note: Climbing ladders. The ladders themselves are noted by whatever draws them (src/systems/world/ladders.gd: StationHull's roof and gantry ladders on the skimmer outposts, StationFill's stacked shacks and containers in the favela and the engine rooms' catwalk ladders). 'climb' is read by src/systems/player/ladder_climb.gd: walk into a ladder's foot holding W and you step on over mount_s seconds (feet first_step m up); W climbs at climb_speed m/s (climb_accel m/s^2 to get there and to stop); your feet come within top_out_below m of the floor at the top and you climb out over top_out_s seconds (top_rise of it pulling up over the lip, the rest stepping out onto the floor) where there is room to stand, else you hang there. [E] on the floor by a ladder's top swings you onto it over top_in_s seconds (top_turn of it back over the lip, turning round). S slides down, up to slide_speed m/s at slide_accel m/s^2; let go and you grip, slowing at slide_brake m/s^2. Space lets go: let_go_push m/s back off the ladder and let_go_up m/s up. rung: the rungs' spacing (m), for the climbing cycle and its sounds. 'words': PlayerClimber's prompts on the gear HUD.
